SamplesAnalysisID.title: Samples Analysis ID
SamplesAnalysisID.description: The OSDU Identifier for this SamplesAnalysis.

SampleID.title: Sample ID
SampleID.description: The OSDU Identifier for the Sample associated with this analysis.

Meta.title: Meta
Meta.description: A meta data item, which allows the association of named properties or property values to a Unit/Measurement/CRS/Azimuth/Time context.

NMRTest.title: NMR Test
NMRTest.description: An analysis of rock or fluid samples using Nuclear Magnetic Resonance to assess various properties, including fluid content and pore structure.

kind.title: UOM Reference Kind
kind.description: The kind of reference, 'Unit' for FrameOfReferenceUOM.

name.title: UOM Unit Symbol
name.description: The unit symbol or name of the unit.

persistableReference.title: UOM Persistable Reference
persistableReference.description: The self-contained, persistable reference string uniquely identifying the Unit.

unitOfMeasureID.title: Unitofmeasureid
unitOfMeasureID.description: SRN to unit of measure reference.

propertyNames.title: UOM Property Names
propertyNames.description: The list of property names, to which this meta data item provides Unit context to. A full path like "StructureA.PropertyB" is required to define a unique context; "data" is omitted since frame-of reference normalization only applies to the data block.

kind.title: CRS Reference Kind
kind.description: The kind of reference, constant 'CRS' for FrameOfReferenceCRS.

persistableReference.title: CRS Persistable Reference
persistableReference.description: The self-contained, persistable reference string uniquely identifying the CRS.

propertyNames.title: CRS Property Names
propertyNames.description: The list of property names, to which this meta data item provides CRS context to. A full path like "StructureA.PropertyB" is required to define a unique context; "data" is omitted since frame-of reference normalization only applies to the data block.

kind.title: DateTime Reference Kind
kind.description: The kind of reference, constant 'DateTime', for FrameOfReferenceDateTime.

name.title: DateTime Name
name.description: The name of the DateTime format and reference.

persistableReference.title: DateTime Persistable Reference
persistableReference.description: The self-contained, persistable reference string uniquely identifying DateTime reference.

propertyNames.title: DateTime Property Names
propertyNames.description: The list of property names, to which this meta data item provides DateTime context to. A full path like "StructureA.PropertyB" is required to define a unique context; "data" is omitted since frame-of reference normalization only applies to the data block.

kind.title: AzimuthReference Reference Kind
kind.description: The kind of reference, constant 'AzimuthReference', for FrameOfReferenceAzimuthReference.

name.title: AzimuthReference Name
name.description: The name of the CRS or the symbol/name of the unit.

persistableReference.title: AzimuthReference Persistable Reference
persistableReference.description: The self-contained, persistable reference string uniquely identifying AzimuthReference.

propertyNames.title: AzimuthReference Property Names
propertyNames.description: The list of property names, to which this meta data item provides AzimuthReference context to. A full path like "StructureA.PropertyB" is required to define a unique context; "data" is omitted since frame-of reference normalization only applies to the data block.

Value.title: Value
Value.description: The porosity value of the sample.

PorosityMeasurementTypeID.title: Porosity Measurement Type ID
PorosityMeasurementTypeID.description: The type of porosity being measured, e.g. BrineSaturation, HeliumInjection.

PorosityMeasurementTypeID.title: Porosity Measurement Type ID
PorosityMeasurementTypeID.description: The type of porosity being measured, e.g. BrineSaturation, HeliumInjection.

CumulativeVolume.title: Cumulative Volume
CumulativeVolume.description: Cumulative volume of fluid calculated based on amplitude measurement.

IncrementalWaterSaturation.title: Incremental Water Saturation
IncrementalWaterSaturation.description: Water saturation increment for this test step.

IncrementalVolume.title: Incremental Volume
IncrementalVolume.description: Incremental volume of fluid calculated based on amplitude measurement.

T2FullySaturated.title: T2 Fully Saturated
T2FullySaturated.description: T2 (transverse or spin-spin relaxation) when the sample is fully saturated.

T2PartiallySaturated.title: T2 Partially Saturated
T2PartiallySaturated.description: T2 (transverse or spin-spin relaxation) when the sample is partially saturated.

T1CumulativePorosity.title: T1 Cumulative Porosity
T1CumulativePorosity.description: Cumulative porosity of the sample based on T1.

T1CumulativeWaterSaturation.title: T1 Cumulative Water Saturation
T1CumulativeWaterSaturation.description: Cumulative water saturation of the sample based on T1.

T1IncrementalPorosity.title: T1 Incremental Porosity
T1IncrementalPorosity.description: Incremental porosity of the sample based on T1.

T1IncrementalWaterSaturation.title: T1 Incremental Water Saturation
T1IncrementalWaterSaturation.description: Incremental water saturation of the sample based on T1.

PorosityMeasurementTypeID.title: Porosity Measurement Type ID
PorosityMeasurementTypeID.description: The classification of porosity measured in the NMR test, which could be based on the method of measurement or the characteristics of the pore spaces.

PermeabilityMeasurementTypeID.title: Permeability Measurement Type ID
PermeabilityMeasurementTypeID.description: The type of permeability being measured, e.g. Gas, PulseDecay, Klinkenberg.

BoundFluidBVI.title: Bound Fluid BVI
BoundFluidBVI.description: Bound fluid following sample desaturation, relative to pore volume.

NMRT2BoundFluidRelativetoPoreVolume.title: NMRT2BoundFluidRelativetoPoreVolume
NMRT2BoundFluidRelativetoPoreVolume.description: NMR T2 bound fluid relative to pore volume.

DisplacedFluidID.title: Displaced Fluid ID
DisplacedFluidID.description: The type of fluid displaced during the NMR test, which can influence the interpretation of pore and fluid properties.

EchoSpacing.title: Echo Spacing
EchoSpacing.description: The time interval between successive echoes in a sequence of pulse and acquisition events.

FreeFluidFFI.title: Free Fluid FFI
FreeFluidFFI.description: Free fluid following sample desaturation, relative to pore volume.

NMRT2FreeFluid.title: NMR T2 Free Fluid
NMRT2FreeFluid.description: The amount of NMR T2 free fluid expressed relative to pore volume.

InjectionFluidID.title: Injected Fluid ID
InjectionFluidID.description: The type of fluid injected into the sample during the NMR test, used to assess how different fluids affect the sample's magnetic resonance properties.

Porosity.title: Porosity
Porosity.description: The amount of pore space relative to the volume of a sample.

Permeability.title: Permeability
Permeability.description: The permeability of the sample as determined by the NMR test, reflecting the ability of fluids to flow through the rock or material.

Swirr.title: Irreducible Water Saturation
Swirr.description: The irreducible water saturation relative to pore volume of the sample.

NMRT2Swirr.title: NMR T2 Irreducible Water Saturation
NMRT2Swirr.description: NMR T2 irreducible water saturation relative to pore volume of the sample.

T2CutOff.title: T2 Cut Off
T2CutOff.description: Cut off of transverse relaxation time (T2).

Temperature.title: Temperature
Temperature.description: The temperature of the test environment.

PoreVolume.title: Pore Volume
PoreVolume.description: The pore volume of the sample.

NetConfiningStress.title: Net Confining Stress
NetConfiningStress.description: The pressure exerted on a sample from its environment, minus the pore pressure within the sample.

TestConditionID.title: Test Condition ID
TestConditionID.description: The sample condition at which the NMR test was conducted.

NMRTestSteps.title: NMR Test Steps
NMRTestSteps.description: An array capturing the individual test steps for this NMR analysis.

NMRSummaryData.title: NMR Summary Data
NMRSummaryData.description: A summary of results from the NMR test, providing key metrics and findings related to the analysis.
